source.url_policy: Public profile paths are retained; query values are redacted. No card token, cookie, authorization header, contact data, or private media URL is recorded.
source.browser_evidence: Terra supplied the public-profile shape observations and the repeatable Playwright/Chromium cold-warm matrix. See browser_baseline_evidence for exact settings and results.

observed.query_comparison: The direct URL without the query had the same observed title/body, language, direction, link count (9), and image count (9). This does not establish that analytics or other non-visible effects are absent.

observed_common.overflow_scope: Unfixed browser viewport only; this is not mobile or desktop acceptance evidence.

browser_baseline_evidence.profile_sampling_deviation: Owner states no-cover/gallery profiles are not realistic or needed for this cohort. These exact five owner-supplied profiles were sampled; this Phase 0 sampling deviation does not delete product parity requirements.

devices.mobile-lab: 390x844, device scale 1, CPU 4x, CDP RTT 150ms, download 200KB/s, upload 100KB/s

browser_baseline_evidence.cache: Browser cache enabled; each cold/warm pair used a fresh isolated context, cold initial navigation and immediate warm same-URL navigation. CDN bypass was not used.
browser_baseline_evidence.runs: 10 cold/warm pairs per profile and device setting; 5 profiles x 2 settings x 10 pairs = 100 pairs and 200 page navigations. 100 direct-media GETs were separate and did not inherit CDP throttling.

results.page_responses: 200/200 HTTP 200; zero navigation/request failures; zero horizontal overflow; all documents lang=ar and dir=rtl, including even-cafe with English visible identity.

limitations.physical_android: Unavailable permanently per owner; remains an unmet physical-device gate. Mobile emulation is not physical-device evidence.
limitations.synthetic_card: No real dedicated non-secret synthetic /c/{token} was discoverable; journey not run and unverified.
limitations.console: One console error in the first 40 navigations; console collection unavailable for the remaining 160.
limitations.interaction_proxy: Unavailable; no harmless representative action common to the profiles was established.

browser_baseline_evidence.transition_decision: Owner explicitly accepts the above limitations for transition to P0.3 only. They remain unmet/unavailable and are not passing measurements. Phase 0 is not passed or complete.
browser_baseline_evidence.menu_discrepancy: Unresolved PRD-versus-plan has_menu profile-link requirement; this sample does not change that contract.

non_claims: This browser matrix is desktop/mobile-lab evidence, not physical-device evidence.
The owner-approved no-cover/gallery sampling deviation does not remove those product parity requirements.
No dedicated synthetic active-card journey or /c/{token} result is recorded; this gate remains unverified.
Physical low-end Android, cache-disabled diagnostic, complete console visibility, and interaction proxy remain unmet/unavailable despite transition authorization.
The query comparison does not establish that analytics or other non-visible query effects are absent.
The supplied query URL is /b/{slug}; it is not a synthetic /c/{token} card journey.

P0.2 is complete only for transition under the owner's accepted limitations; this artifact does not pass Phase 0 or prove Cloudflare routing, cache, Worker, origin, purge, slug-update, or Menu coexistence gates.
missing_gates: The dedicated synthetic active-card /c/{token} journey was not run and remains unverified.
The physical low-end Android/mobile-network gate remains unmet; cache-disabled diagnostic, full console collection, and interaction proxy are unavailable.
Complete the P0.3 disposable slug-update check and the remaining P0.4 comparison and route-contract decisions.

menu_discrepancy.detail: The PRD requires a published has_menu profile link contract, while the active plan excludes a Menu-enabled public profile because the owner says that profile feature is future work. The synthetic /menu/* route fixture is not evidence that the profile-link requirement is implemented.
